input_protocol.pooling: mean over unique source positions; repeated prefix/BOS/EOS averaged across windows

encoder_precision: FP32 weights/optimizer; BF16 CUDA autocast; FP32 head/pooling/loss
classifier_initialization: shared base RNG; LoRA initialization isolated; training RNG reset

weighting.normalization: divide by raw mean within each Train label
weighting.features: log1p visible tokens/chars/lines + lexical TF-IDF; fold-local scaler/vocabulary
weighting.grouping: transitive counterpart/pair identities and full/visible normalized source duplicates

selection: original Valid MCC threshold/epoch selection and tie-break
loss: mean(weight * BCEWithLogits); fixed weights; no oversampling
